positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Obsidian developed and maintained under tech accelerator OS Labs (opensourcelabs.io);
A GraphQL caching solution for deno runtime environment.
--Provides caching solution and server module to handle complexities of caching in GraphQL, along with full demo app and integrated dev tool to provide real-time latency measurements for queries and mutations in GUI 
--Leveraged Deno to provide secure runtime environment, cleaner asynchronous code, decentralized package management and native support for both Javascript and Typescript
--Used Docker to consolidate and streamline deployment, resolving dependency conflicts across several repositories arising from multiple previous iterations
--Implemented customizable server side write through and write back strategies to allow clients to configure functionality to suit their unique needs and compare latency in real time within Chrome developer tool
--Made use of Rhum’s lightweight framework to build modular, easily-parsed state management test suite for core features
--Created modular middleware functionality within Oak to process HTTP requests in Deno, supporting separated, reusable server logic. 
--Leveraged React’s streamlined state control to allow increased modularization of metric and caching tools, creating a clean and minimal client experience in combination with abstracted DOM manipulation for contributing developers
--Employed TypeScript static typing to simplify and streamline app configurations, as well as minimize silent failures 
--Provided modularized, declarative routing using React Router to provide seamless client-side rendering, enabling instant graphical representation of query response times in developer tool
--Built-in polling with custom method to ensure freshness of dev tool’s data even while application is idle

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
CharityApp | Charitable donation platform with online payment support and personal spending metrics
--Streamlined conditional rendering of multiple components in SPA using React Router to create simple, user-friendly UI
--Utilized Express to modularize backend logic and calls to multiple APIs
--Integrated Plaid API sandbox to streamline online payment process through secure API to connect users, charities and financial accounts while ensuring security
--Streamlined auth utilizing BCrypt’s customizable hash method to ensure effective data hashing while minimizing latency
--Led daily PR reviews and standups, established and maintained style rules and code merging review process to facilitate team coherence 
--Leveraged third-party APIs to access detailed information for charitable organizations, preloaded critical API assets to ensure seamless user experience
